Rollmann Trading Company
========================

Rollmann Trading Company (founded 1985) is India's premier authorized stockist and direct factory importer for THK Co., Ltd. (Japan), Oiles Corporation, and Zimmer Group. Serving machine tool manufacturers, factory automation integrators, aerospace, robotics, and medical device builders nationwide.

Company Information
-------------------
- Name: Rollmann Trading Company
- Website: https://rollmann.in
- Authorized Stockist Status: THK Japan Official Stockist (Linear Motion Systems, LM Guides, Ball Screws, Linear Bushings)
- Key Partner Brands: THK Co., Ltd. (Japan), Oiles Corporation (Self-Lubricating Bearings), Zimmer Group (Pneumatic Rail Clamping Elements), FAG/INA Bearings
- Head Office: 55, 3rd Main Road, New Tharagupet, Bengaluru - 560002, Karnataka, India
- Regional Distribution Hubs: Bengaluru (Central Warehouse), Pune (MIDC Bhosari), New Delhi, Ahmedabad, Chennai
- Phone: +91 80 26609630 / +91 80 26611383
- Email: sales@rollmann.in
- Delivery Coverage: Nationwide delivery across India within 24 to 48 hours for standard stock

Core Product Portfolio
----------------------

1. THK Linear Bushings (LM Series)
- High-precision recirculating ball linear bushings with cylindrical outer cylinder and resin/metal retainers
- Standard Series: LM6UU, LM8UU, LM10UU, LM12UU, LM16UU, LM20UU, LM25UU, LM30UU, LM40UU, LM50UU
- Configurations: Standard cylindrical, Clearance-Adjustable (-AJ), Open-type (-OP), High-temperature stainless GA (-GA)
- Shaft Fit Standards: ISO 286 g6 (Standard normal clearance), h6 (Precision zero-play fit), f6 (Loose fit)
- Interactive Configurator: https://rollmann.in/linear-bush.html

2. THK LM Guides & Rails (Linear Motion Guides)
- Heavy-load 4-way equal-load profile rail guides
- Series: HSR (HSR15, HSR20, HSR25, HSR30, HSR35, HSR45, HSR55), SHS (4-way equal load caged ball), SSR (compact), SRS (miniature stainless)
- Block Styles: HSR-A (flanged with tapped holes), HSR-B (flanged with through holes), HSR-R (narrow block)
- Rail Cutting: Custom cut-to-length rail service with +-0.5mm precision and symmetrical end pitch

3. Precision Ball Screws & Support Units
- Ground precision ball screws conforming to JIS B 1192 accuracy classes C3 and C5
- Series: BNK, BIF (preloaded double nut), BLK/WTF (high lead), DIR (integral nut)
- CNC Machining: End journaling, turning, and threading for BK/BF and FK/FF fixed and supported bearing units

4. Cam Followers & Roller Followers
- Stud-type needle roller bearings with integrated precision stud and hexagonal wrench socket
- Series: CF, CFH, CFT, CF-AB with eccentric stud adjustment

5. Cross Roller Rings
- High-rigidity crossed roller bearings capable of receiving radial, axial, and moment loads simultaneously
- Series: RB, RE, RU (integrated inner/outer ring) for robotic joints, rotary tables, and machine tool spindles

6. Oiles Self-Lubricating Bearings
- Oiles 500SP solid bronze embedded with solid lubricant plugs for high load, low velocity, water, and chemical resistance
- Oiles Drymet composite bushings (LFB, LF)

7. Zimmer Group Clamping & Braking Elements
- Pneumatic and manual linear guide rail clamps (MBPS, UBPS, LBHS) for emergency braking and zero-backlash holding

Engineering Tools & Calculators
-------------------------------
- THK Kinematic Fatigue Life Calculator (L10 travel in km and L10h operating hours)
- ISO 286 Shaft and Housing Tolerance Fit Visualizer
- Project BOM Specification Transmittal and CSV Export
